changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as it's not studied/evaluated in the paper (only DST). Removed generic 'T5' and 'BERT-base' (benchmark models). Added more precise output description. Tasks were normalized to standard naming convention.
Normalized all variations to standard 'Joint Goal Accuracy' using consistent capitalization
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper - LLMs (T5) were used for generation only
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper - only automatic evaluation with Joint Goal Accuracy

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Dialogue State Tracking (DST) using language models. While DST involves generating text (slot values), it's primarily a structured prediction task rather than free-form NLG. The paper evaluates using only automatic metrics (Joint Goal Accuracy) without LLM-as-judge or human evaluations. The extraction correctly identified the main contributions but included some benchmark models and tasks that aren't part of the core study.
